text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"We want to thank the academy staff." The 
day to put Satono Diamond's heartfelt plan 
into action had finally arrived—!

text_block_list.name: Commentator Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Now then, it's finally starting: the 
"Academy Staff Appreciation Race"!

text_block_list.name: Commentator Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
In front of the gates awaiting the race 
start, sparks are already flying among the 
first runners!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Thank you all for helping out! Let's do 
our best today, desu!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Likewise. It is a precious opportunity to 
show our daily gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
...I certainly cannot afford to lose this 
race♪

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
El isn't gonna lose either, no way! In a 
fierce battle, 1st place, to say gracias 
to the staff desu!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
! For the sake of the academy staff 
members who always take care of us—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
We want to hold an "Appreciation Race" for 
the staff!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Since then, Satono Diamond and the others 
had spent day after day preparing for the 
race.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
—The final 12th race is Turf 1200m. With 
this, all the cards for the day are 
completely decided!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Now then, let's go deliver the invitations 
to all the staff members right away.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, but it's alright! I want to 
hand them out directly with my own hands.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for always maintaining the 
grounds so carefully. We truly want to 
show you the fruits of our training here—

text_block_list.name: Maintenance Staff
text_block_list.text:
Going out of your way just for us...! On 
that day, we'll be cheering you on with 
all our might!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
The meals you make for us are 
indispensable for building bodies capable 
of tackling races!

text_block_list.name: Cafeteria Staff
text_block_list.text:
Hearing you say that makes it all worth 
it... Thank you, I'm really looking 
forward to it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though Satono Diamond had agonized over 
how to express her gratitude to the staff, 
her answer was simple.
choice_data_list:
(Repaying their cheers for our running 
with our running, huh)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Once again, everyone! Thank you so very 
much for gathering today!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Holding precious dreams close to our 
chests... we horse girls stepped through 
the gates of this academy.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
That we can chase those dreams day after 
day without a single worry is all thanks 
to the tremendous support of the academy's 
staff members.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's support pushes us forward from 
behind... Just how much power that gives 
us—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Please witness it for yourselves today!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOAAAAAH—!)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Trainer-san! You were watching!
choice_data_list:
It looks like your feelings came through 
loud and clear!

Looks like your feelings really reached 
them!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
And hearing those cheers just now made me 
truly realize once more just how many 
people are rooting for us!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san! Thank you so very much for 
helping out with so many things!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Allow me to offer my congratulations 
on holding the race as well♪

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
All the staff members were truly 
delighted, and it warmed my heart too!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
By the way... do the two of you have any 
plans after today's races?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Actually, upon hearing about this, the 
Chairwoman told me she wished to reward 
the staff and horse girls for their hard 
work—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
So we've prepared a modest little 
after-party♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Wah, really! Then we'll get to talk with 
the staff members even more!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
If that's the case... first I must tackle 
the race with all my strength...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Heeey, Dia-chaaan! It's almost our turn to 
run—!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Okay, Kita-chan! I'll be right there!
choice_data_list: Give it your all! I'm rooting for you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the "Academy Staff Appreciation 
Race" hosted by Satono Diamond concluded 
with immense success—!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ah, there you are, Dia-chan! It's almost 
our turn!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
We've gotta prepare properly and show them 
the best race ever!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, wait up, Kita-chan. I'm coming right 
now!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Well then... please watch over me, 
Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I will answer the feelings of everyone 
supporting us with my absolute best run—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The heated races continued, driving the 
excitement of the venue to its peak. The 
finale, of course, was the Winning Live 
performed by today's runners—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Lastly, with our very special gratitude, 
we shall sing this song!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
May our feelings reach you all— The song 
is: "We are DREAMERS!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond and the others' singing 
voices resonated powerfully and 
boundlessly into the distance.
